name: PBO to Texture Copy for Display
aliases: OpenGL Display via PBO and Texture
definition: Display routine that updates the view matrix, renders the volume, clears the screen, copies data from the CUDA PBO to an OpenGL texture, and draws a textured quad.
summary: PBO to Texture Copy for Display transfers rendered volume data from a CUDA-registered Pixel Buffer Object to an OpenGL texture for screen display, avoiding CPU memory latency through explicit buffer synchronization.
